en: Colorized vintage image of a large villa or hotel on a gentle hillside, with a tall white tower topped by a steep red roof and weather vane. The main building has red-brown tiled roofs, balconies, and multiple windows, surrounded by a low wall and some sparse vegetation. In the foreground there is a simple white wooden fence or bridge-like railing; the sky is bright with scattered clouds. No visible printed text or caption appears on the image side provided.
